annotations.title: YAML to JSON: convert a YAML document into JSON

description:
Convert a YAML document (config files, Kubernetes manifests, OpenAPI specs, front matter) into JSON, parsed by the yaml library with anchors and aliases resolved (alias expansion capped against billion-laughs documents) and duplicate keys refused. Up to 100 KB. Use before feeding YAML into a JSON-only tool or schema check; for the reverse use json_to_yaml. Invalid YAML is a 400 with the parser's message, uncharged. Example: yaml=name: agent
ports:
  - 80
  - 443
enabled: true. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
